center/cover no-repeat;transform:scale(1.02)} .landing-header{position:relative;z-index:2;height:92px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 42px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(12,75,130,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(5px)} .brand-official,.brand-humanity{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px} .brand-official img{width:62px;height:62px;object-fit:contain}.brand-humanity img{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:contain} .brand-official b{display:block;color:#0d3f70;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.2px}.brand-official span{display:block;color:#66809a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:3px} .brand-humanity{text-align:right;color:#0d3f70}.brand-humanity b{display:block;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1.5px}.brand-humanity span{font-size:10px;color:#1678bd;letter-spacing:2px} .landing-main{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:68px 26px 35px;text-align:center} .landing-kicker{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2.2px;color:#55758e} .landing-main h1{font-size:42px;line-height:1.08;margin:10px 0 8px;color:#103f6e;font-weight:500}.landing-main h1 strong{font-weight:900} .landing-desc{max-width:740px;margin:auto;color:#647c91;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6} .role-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:38px} .role-card{border:1px solid rgba(20,73,112,.15);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(19,63,99,.13);padding:26px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;color:#163f66} .role-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 20px 45px rgba(19,63,99,.19)} .role-card .role-symbol{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#e8f3fb;color:#1678bd;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:16px} .role-card strong{display:block;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.4px}.role-card small{display:block;color:#6d8092;line-height:1.55;min-height:40px;margin:7px 0 15px;font-size:12px}.role-card em{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#1678bd} .role-card.control .role-symbol{background:#e7f6f1;color:#158061}.role-card.control em{color:#158061}.role-card.report .role-symbol{background:#fff3dc;color:#b87900}.role-card.report em{color:#b87900} .landing-foot{margin-top:27px;font-size:10px;color:#8293a2} .access-gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(7,32,54,.76);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px} .access-card{width:min(460px,100%);background:#fff;border-radius:19px;padding:30px;box-shadow:0 25px 75px rgba(0,0,0,.28);text-align:center} .access-logos{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:17px}.access-logos img{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:contain} .access-kicker{margin-top:13px;color:#71879b;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px}.access-card h2{margin:6px 0 2px;color:#123f6d;font-size:24px}.access-card p{margin:0;color:#77899a;font-size:12px} .access-card label{display:block;text-align:left;margin:22px 0 6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#5d7184}.access-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px}.access-row input{border:1px solid #ccd7e0;border-radius:9px;padding:12px;font:inherit;min-width:0} #accessError{min-height:18px;color:#b83232;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-top:7px}.back-link{border:0;background:transparent;color:#60788d;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-top:9px} .hidden{display:none!important} .grid6{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(145px,1fr))}.metric{min-width:0;overflow:hidden}.metric .value{font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,19px)!important;white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;line-height:1.18!important;letter-spacing:-.25px}.metric .label{white-space:normal} @media(max-width:1200px){.grid6{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(145px,1fr))}} @media(max-width:850px){.role-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.landing-header{padding:10px 18px}.brand-official b{font-size:14px}.brand-humanity{display:none}.landing-main{padding-top:45px}.landing-main h1{font-size:31px}.grid6{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(135px,1fr))}} @media(max-width:480px){.grid6{grid-template-columns:1fr}.access-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
